text:
Maya: Quick sync — need a final copy pass for the launch: landing pages (Hosted API / Reserved capacity / Private deployment), 4 social launch posts, webinar hook, benchmark snippet, and inbound lead routing. Who can take which pieces? :rocket:
Evan: I can outline the 3 value props per page. Hosted = fastest time-to-value; Reserved = predictable latency & throughput; Private = compliance & VPC control. Keep headlines short.
Lina: I'll own the launch post schedule + webinar cadence. Proposing: 1 teaser post, 2 benchmark-led posts, 1 webinar invite, follow-up email. 2-week promo window. :calendar:
Sam: Drafts below — rough headline + 3 bullets each and CTAs. Please react with preferred CTAs.
Sam: ```Hosted API
Headline: "Integrate LLMs in minutes, not months"
Bullets: "Fastest time-to-value, curated open models, streaming responses + SDKs"
CTA options: "Try Hosted API", "Start with free credits"

Reserved Capacity (Dedicated)
Headline: "Predictable throughput for production LLMs"
Bullets: "Dedicated GPU pools, SLA-backed latency, autoscale + burst"
CTA options: "Reserve capacity", "Talk to sales"

Private Deployment
Headline: "Run inference behind your network"
Bullets: "VPC & on-prem options, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs"
CTA options: "Request demo", "Get private deployment guide"
```
Jules: For inbound routing: webinar signups + enterprise form -> Sales SDR queue; "Request demo" and large org contact forms -> AE; webinar attendees who watched >50% -> MQL -> Growth nurture. Use `company_size` and `email_domain` to route.
Lina: For benchmark posts we need a single short stat for hero social cards. Evan — can you confirm a vetted stat? e.g., "up to 60% lower per-token cost vs baseline" or actual numbers we'd publish.
Evan: I'll confirm numbers with infra/benchmarks team by EOD. Tentative line: "costs down by up to 60% on typical chat workloads with batching + KV cache" — need ops signoff.
Maya: Good. We also need canonical UTM and lead tags. Proposed UTM pattern: `utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tri_launch_2026`. Use `lead_route` tag values: `self_serve`, `growth`, `enterprise`.
Sam: A/B ideas: headline test for Hosted: 1) "Integrate LLMs in minutes, not months" vs 2) "Ship LLM features faster — powered by Redwood". I'll set up copy test for hero + CTA.
Jules: Reminder: make webinar sign-up include company size and "budget" dropdown so routing is deterministic. Also add hidden field `lead_route` default `self_serve` for CAPI signups.
deploy-bot: Preview build deployed to staging at https://staging.redwood-inference.com/preview/launch-173210 — screenshots in the doc. :computer:
Maya: Action items: Sam finalize copy and CTAs (EOD), Lina schedule social + webinar draft (tomorrow), Evan confirm benchmark stat (today), Jules configure routing rules and form fields (tomorrow). Ping me when deployed to prod preview. :eyes:
